evals.prompt: Render a photorealistic still of a red vintage sports car parked on a foggy mountain road at dawn on Higgsfield in 1080p.
evals.expected_output: Claude uses the higgsfield-mcp server flow: confirms HF_API_KEY/HF_SECRET are present (debug_credentials), submits a generate_image (Soul) job with the prompt at 1080p, polls get_generation_status until the job completes, and returns the finished image URL.
expectations: Submits an image generation job via the higgsfield-mcp generate_image tool, not a video tool
Polls get_generation_status until the job finishes before returning a result
Returns the final hosted image URL to the user
References that HF_API_KEY/HF_SECRET credentials are required and that the job consumes credits

evals.prompt: I have this prompt: 'a cozy reading nook with warm lamplight, oil-painting style'. Can you actually generate that picture on Higgsfield for me?
evals.expected_output: Claude treats this as an image generation request, loads the deferred higgsfield MCP tools if needed (ToolSearch), submits the prompt to generate_image on the Higgsfield Soul/Seedream model, polls status to completion, and returns the resulting image URL.
expectations: Calls the higgsfield-mcp generate_image tool with the user-supplied prompt text
Loads or references the deferred higgsfield MCP tools via ToolSearch before invoking them if they are not yet available
Follows the submit -> poll status -> return output URL flow rather than browser automation
Does not animate the image into a video (stays an image-only generation)

evals.prompt: Make a 720p product hero shot of a matte-black wireless earbuds case floating on a gradient background on Higgsfield Soul.
evals.expected_output: Claude verifies Higgsfield credentials, submits a generate_image job on the Soul model at 720p quality through the higgsfield-mcp server, polls get_generation_status until complete, and returns the finished image URL while noting credit consumption.
expectations: Submits a generate_image job to the Higgsfield Soul model at 720p quality
Uses the higgsfield-mcp API flow (submit generate_image -> poll get_generation_status -> return output URL)
Produces a single still image and does not invoke any seedance or video generation tool
Notes that the job requires HF_API_KEY/HF_SECRET and consumes Higgsfield credits
